# NavigationRail/Sidebar

Figma: [06j. NavigationRail/Sidebar](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-940) · Family: 06 Navigation · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-06-17

Persistent vertical navigation for tablet & desktop - the rail counterpart of the bottom TabBar. 3–7 destinations, active = brand, inactive = neutral, RTL-mirrored.

### NavRailItem

One destination in NavigationRail or AppSidebar: Stacked icon over label when collapsed or Row icon plus title when expanded, with active pill, badge, submenu chevron and overflow action options.

Level: molecule · Contains: Badge Count, Badge Dot · Part of: NavigationRail, AppSidebar (shadcn-style)

Use when:
- Inside NavigationRail or AppSidebar (shadcn-style); swap Icon and set the label
- Showing a count or dot on a destination (Show badge)
- Expandable group with children (Show chevron)

Don't use when:
- Mobile bottom navigation: use BottomNavTabItem
- Rows in a page list: use ListItem
- Overflow command rows: use MenuItem

Accessibility: aria-current=page when active; collapsed items need a tooltip and aria-label; badge counts announced (3 new).

Don't use when:

### Icon / nav-toggle-menu

Hamburger glyph that expands a collapsed NavigationRail.

Level: atom · Part of: NavigationRail

Use when:
- Toggle control in a collapsed NavigationRail or AppSidebar header

Don't use when:
- Opening a menu of commands: use MenuTrigger (Glyph=hamburger)
- Collapsing an expanded rail: use Icon / nav-toggle-chevron

Accessibility: Wrap in a button with aria-label Expand navigation and aria-expanded=false.

_No properties._

Don't use when:

Accessibility: Button with aria-label Collapse navigation and aria-expanded=true.

_No properties._

### AppSidebar (shadcn-style)

Published shadcn-style application sidebar for web: workspace switcher, search, grouped NavRailItems (Platform, Projects), pinned settings/help and a user footer, expanded or collapsed. The library-ready desktop navigation shell.

Level: organism · Contains: NavRail / TeamSwitcher, NavRail / NavUser, NavRailItem, Search Input

Use when:
- Web and back-office app shells with grouped destinations and a workspace switcher
- Desktop layouts that need search plus account menu in the sidebar
- Variant=Floating or Inset when the sidebar should sit as a card beside content

Don't use when:
- Mobile: use TabBar (3-tab)
- Simple rail without workspace or search: use NavigationRail
- Temporary navigation over content: use Drawer

Accessibility: nav landmark with group labels as headings; collapse toggle exposes aria-expanded; sits on the right edge in RTL.

### NavigationRail

Persistent vertical navigation for tablet and desktop, the rail counterpart of the bottom TabBar: wordmark and toggle, grouped NavRailItems with badges and submenus, account pinned at the bottom; Expanded (about 240px) or Collapsed (about 80px).

Level: organism · Contains: NavRailItem, Brand / Safqah Wordmark (Dark), Icon / nav-toggle-menu, Icon / nav-toggle-chevron, Divider

Use when:
- Tablet and desktop layouts with 3 to 7 top-level destinations
- Web investor portal using the same destinations as the mobile TabBar
- Mode=Collapsed to reclaim width on data-heavy screens

Don't use when:
- Mobile: use TabBar (3-tab)
- Deep or temporary hierarchies: use Drawer
- Needing a published library shell with workspace switcher and search: use AppSidebar (shadcn-style)

Accessibility: nav landmark, exactly one aria-current=page item, tooltips for collapsed labels; anchored to the right edge in RTL.

> Not published to the Figma library. Use it by name everywhere; in another Figma file take its published route or copy it from the Syntropy file (syntropy-components, unpublished.md).

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

NavigationRail is the persistent vertical navigation for tablet & desktop - the rail counterpart of the bottom TabBar (06b). Same destinations and the same visual language: active = brand, inactive = neutral.

### When to use

- Tablet & desktop layouts (≥ medium width) where a persistent side nav fits, with 3–7 top-level destinations.
- Alongside content, anchored to the leading edge (left in LTR, right in RTL).

### When not to use

- On mobile - use the bottom TabBar (06b).
- For deep or temporary hierarchies - use a Drawer (06e).

### Anatomy

- Brand mark & toggle - the real Safqah wordmark (dark), pinned to the top, with a control to expand (menu) or collapse (chevron) the rail.
- Nav items - NavRailItem: Stacked (icon over an 11px label) when collapsed, or Row (24px icon + 14px title) when expanded; optionally grouped under uppercase subtitles.
- Active indicator, badges & submenus - a bg/brand/primary-subtle pill marks the active item; DS Badge counts/dots and expandable submenus are built in.
- Bottom slot - account / settings pinned to the bottom via a flexible spacer.
- Inner border - border/subtle, separating the rail from page content.

### Modes - expanded & collapsed

Two modes set the size - Expanded (≈ 240px) and Collapsed (icon, ≈ 80px) - toggled with the header control. Three shadcn-style variants (Standard · Floating · Inset) set the surface, and five booleans (header, group labels, badges, submenu, footer) tune the rest.

### Expanded

- Icon + title beside the full Safqah wordmark, with grouped sections, subtitles, badges and expandable submenus. The default when the rail has room (≈ 240px wide).

### Collapsed

- Icon over an 11px label, narrow (≈ 80px) with a scaled wordmark, a menu control and dot badges. Reclaims horizontal space; pair with tooltips on hover.

### Item states

Item state is inherited from the NavRailItem atom - reused from the TabBar's BottomNavTabItem.

- Active - icon/brand/primary + text/brand/primary (SemiBold), with the indicator pill.
- Inactive - icon/subtle + text/muted (Medium).
- Hover - icon/default + text/default, for desktop pointer feedback.

### Direction - LTR and RTL

The rail mirrors with reading direction.

- LTR - rail on the left edge; inner border on the right; Latin labels.
- RTL - rail on the right edge; inner border on the left; Arabic labels in Noto Sans Arabic.

### Behavior

- Exactly one item is active - the current destination; the indicator and brand colour move with it.
- Keep 3–7 destinations; overflow collapses into a “More” item or a Drawer.
- The rail spans the full viewport height; the bottom slot stays pinned.
- Pair with the same destinations as the mobile TabBar so navigation is consistent across breakpoints.

### Code examples

### HTML · ARIA

```dart
<nav class="rail" aria-label="Primary">
  <a class="rail-item is-active" href="/home" aria-current="page">
    <svg aria-hidden="true"><!-- home-window --></svg>
    <span>Home</span>
  </a>
  <a class="rail-item" href="/investments">
    <svg aria-hidden="true"><!-- chart-monitoring --></svg>
    <span>Investments</span>
  </a>
</nav>
```

### Usage - Do and Don’t

Do

Do keep exactly one active destination, and pin account / settings to the bottom.

Don’t

Don't use the rail on mobile - switch to the bottom TabBar (06b).

Do

Do mirror the rail to the right edge in RTL, with Arabic labels.

Don’t

Don't exceed ~7 destinations - collapse the rest into a Drawer or a “More” item.

### In this system

- TabBar (06b) - the mobile counterpart
- Drawer (06e) - temporary / deep navigation
- NavRailItem - the item atom
- Badge (04b) - counts & dots
- Divider (04h) - separators

### Notes from the maintainer

Built 2026-06-17. NavigationRail deliberately reuses the TabBar's nav-item DNA and tokens (icon/brand/primary + text/brand/primary active, icon/subtle + text/muted inactive) so the two navigations never drift. The rail adds a hover state and a subtle bg/brand/primary-subtle active indicator pill (rails benefit from a stronger selected cue than the bottom bar). The item icon is an INSTANCE_SWAP; the bottom slot is pinned with a flexible spacer. Grounded against the real Safqah product nav. - Abdulrahman
